span.p: ⑧ 决定下一批数据

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: 有

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: 完成

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
当前 epoch 是否还有
未训练的 minibatch？

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
有
读取下一批 256 条样本
回到步骤③重新前向计算

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
没有
是否已经完成 5 个 epoch？

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
未完成
epoch 加 1 并重新打乱 4,096 条样本
回到步骤②

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
已完成
保留更新后的网络参数
开始下一轮 8 × 512 步采样

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;

span.p: ⑦ 反向传播并更新参数

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
未超过 KL 阈值
清空旧梯度并计算
g = ∇θL

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
全局梯度范数裁剪
g ← g × min(1，0.5 ÷ ‖g‖₂)

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Adam 更新全部参数
θ ← Adam(θ，g)
学习率 10⁻⁴

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
梯度流向
Lᴬ、Lᴴ → Actor
Lⱽ → Critic
三部分共同更新共享 GRU 与投影层

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;

span.p: ⑥ 更新前检查策略变化幅度

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: 是

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
近似 KL
Δℓₜ = log πθ(aₜ｜sₜ) − log π旧(aₜ｜sₜ)
KLapprox = mean(exp(Δℓₜ) − 1 − Δℓₜ)

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
KLapprox > 1.5 × 0.02
也就是大于 0.03？

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
是
停止本轮剩余 minibatch 和 epoch
直接开始下一轮环境采样

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;

span.p: ④ 按当前 Minibatch 计算 Actor 与 Critic 损失

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;

span.p: Critic 路径

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
当前价值预测与固定回归目标
Vθ(sₜ) 和 R̂ₜ

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Critic 损失
Lⱽ = mean(R̂ₜ − Vθ(sₜ))²
价值系数为 0.5，未启用价值裁剪

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;

span.p: Actor 路径

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
联合动作对数概率
log πθ(aₜ｜sₜ)
= log πθ(aᵐₜ｜sₜ) + log πθ(aᴸₜ｜sₜ)
+ log πθ(aᴿₜ｜sₜ)

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
新旧策略概率比
ρₜ(θ) = exp(log πθ(aₜ｜sₜ)
− log π旧(aₜ｜sₜ))

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
PPO 裁剪
ρ̄ₜ = clip(ρₜ，0.8，1.2)
q₁ = ρₜĀₜ，q₂ = ρ̄ₜĀₜ

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Actor 损失
Lᴬ = −mean min(q₁，q₂)

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
熵损失
Lᴴ = −mean Hₜ
熵系数为 0.003

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;

span.p: ③ 当前 Actor-Critic 网络重新前向计算

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
历史观测进入共享编码器
256 × 320 → 256 × 20 × 16
单层 GRU 64 → Linear 64 → 64 + GELU
得到共享特征 fₜ：256 × 64

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Actor 分支
64 → 160 → 160 → 26 logits
拆分为 6、10、10 三组 Categorical
输出当前 log πθ(aₜ｜sₜ) 与策略熵 Hₜ

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Critic 分支
64 → 160 → 160 → 1
输出当前状态价值 Vθ(sₜ)：256 × 1

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;

span.p: ② 组织 Epoch 和 Minibatch

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
开始一个 epoch
随机打乱全部 4,096 条样本

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
依次读取 16 个 minibatch
每批 256 条
一个 epoch 内不重复且完整覆盖

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
当前训练批数据
sₜ：256 × 320，aₜ：256 × 3
V旧(sₜ)、log π旧(aₜ｜sₜ)
Âₜ 与 R̂ₜ

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
仅标准化当前批优势
Āₜ = (Âₜ − mean Â) ÷ (std Â + 10⁻⁸)

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;

span.p: ① 固定本轮 Rollout 数据并计算训练目标

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
RolloutBuffer
8 个环境 × 512 步，共 4,096 条样本
保存 sₜ、aₜ、rₜ、episode start
V旧(sₜ) 与 log π旧(aₜ｜sₜ)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
TD 残差
δₜ = rₜ + γmₜV旧(sₜ₊₁) − V旧(sₜ)
γ = 0.99
真正终止时 mₜ = 0，否则 mₜ = 1

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
从每个环境的时间轴末端向前递推
Âₜ = δₜ + γλmₜÂₜ₊₁
λ = 0.95

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
得到 Critic 回归目标
R̂ₜ = Âₜ + V旧(sₜ)

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
⑤ 合并总损失
L = Lᴬ + 0.5Lⱽ + 0.003Lᴴ
